notes: Run against the same --home as session A/B, after them: this is the advertising half of LUM-1319.
120x34 so the expanded startup header (and therefore the new `Ctrl+R/Ctrl+S to search history` row) is on screen — at 76x26 the header folds itself and the row is not painted.
Panel 2 folds the header (Alt+H) so the transcript has the rows `/hotkeys` needs; without it the legend's navigation section is scrolled off the bottom.
Panels 3/4 split the legend: the tail is painted first, and `Home` (the chat-log jump) brings the navigation section — with both reverse-search rows — onto the screen.

The cleanup entry point is the CLI parameter `pi --clear-history` (not a slash command): it is checked by the gate's integration test and by the shell step right after this scenario, so no TUI row had to be spent on it.
